method: Heuristic market-prioritization scores from reviewed official government sources. Scores measure research friction, not legal risk or permit eligibility.

municipalities.name: Aurora
evidence_basis: Aurora mobile-food operators must satisfy City revenue/registration requirements and operate only at approved locations.
The City's rules distinguish mobile food units, food carts and special-event operations and identify additional event requirements.
City guidance for qualifying event/farmers-market operations references health and fire inspection dependencies alongside municipal registration.

requirements.label: Confirm the applicable Aurora mobile-food registration and approved operating location
Confirm health/fire inspection documentation required for the intended event or market operation

municipalities.name: DeKalb
evidence_basis: Food-vendor readiness can span City licensing/tax requirements and DeKalb County Health Department food permits.
The County publishes distinct temporary, seasonal and mobile food-establishment permit paths and fee schedules.
The County states a temporary-food application timing threshold before late fees apply.
City food licensing can add local restaurant/bar tax or fire-life-safety dependencies depending on operation type.

requirements.label: Identify the applicable City of DeKalb business/food license and local tax path
Identify the applicable County temporary, seasonal or mobile food permit
Confirm whether Fire-Life Safety licensing applies to the operating model

municipalities.name: Downers Grove
evidence_basis: The Village publishes a capped annual mobile-food-vendor permit program and separate renewal timing/fees.
Village application materials depend on a DuPage County Health permit and other operator/vehicle documentation.
Food-truck operation is subject to location, property-consent, hours and distance restrictions.
Village-sponsored festival/event operation can add temporary-use implications depending on location.

requirements.label: Obtain the applicable Village mobile-food-vendor permit
Provide the applicable county health permit and supporting operator/vehicle documents
Check location, distance, event and temporary-use restrictions before committing to a site
